text:
deploy-bot: Started staged rollout: service=redwood-inference-api, from=release/v2.3.9 to=release/v2.4.0, target=10% traffic (global), regions=[us-east-1, eu-west-3], change-window=2026-03-22T19:00Z. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/v2.4.0 :rocket:
emily: Ack. watching graphs now. please ping if any region diverges. :eyes:
samir: Quick heads-up — eu-west-3 shows p95 jump on /v1/generate within first 5m. baseline p95 ~110ms -> 240ms for canary. error rate small but increased 0.4% -> 1.8% on a subset of hosts.
ops: Can you narrow to instance IDs? any 502/timeout vs 5xx?
samir: Mostly 502/504 on edge-proxy logs and a couple of 500s from runtime. attaching snippet:
```
[2026-03-22T19:05:12Z] host=eu3-gpu-7 svc=runtime level=error msg="kv-cache open failed" err="timeout"
[2026-03-22T19:06:03Z] host=eu3-gpu-4 svc=proxy level=warn msg="upstream 502" target=/v1/generate
```
ops: Hmm kv-cache timeouts could explain p95 and 502s. Is this the quantized path change in 2.4.0?
emily: 2.4.0 enabled new kernel selection + async-kv by default (opt-in previously). Could be a regression under eu3 traffic pattern.
jin: Suggest we pause the global ramp and optionally pin eu-west-3 back to v2.3.9 for isolation. We can keep 10% elsewhere while we triage if traffic routing supports region-level pin.
lisa: Change window extends 30m. We should avoid rollback across the whole fleet unless necessary. Also double-check migration toggles — no DB changes in 2.4.0.
ops: @deploy-bot can you pause the staged rollout? need to halt progression and hold at current 10%.
deploy-bot: Command received: pause_rollout(service=redwood-inference-api, rollout_id=rl_1860011222). Status: PAUSED at 10% global.
emily: Good. Now options: 1) targeted region rollback (eu-west-3 only), 2) keep paused and hotfix, 3) full rollback. Thoughts?
samir: eu3-only rollback would reduce customer impact and preserve warmup in other regions. telemetry shows eu3 hosts are the outliers.
jin: We have infra knobs to route EU traffic to us-east temporarily, but that would increase latency for EU users. I'd prefer eu3 pinback to v2.3.9.
lisa: If we pin region, remember to annotate release notes and run quick sanity for kv-cache settings. Assigning ops to run a small config check.
ops: On it. Running quick check: kv-cache alloc sizes + kernel flags on eu3 nodes. Also checking recent infra deploys.
ops: config diff shows: async-kv=true on v2.4.0 nodes, but async-kv=false on v2.3.9. Also one kernel flag changed: prefetch_policy=aggressive.
emily: That aligns with hypothesis. Decision: apply region pinback for eu-west-3 to v2.3.9 and keep global rollout paused. ops will run a config sanity and we triage async-kv path. Vote? :+1: for pinback
jin: +1
samir: +1
lisa: +1
ops: +1
deploy-bot: Executing regional pinback: set_route(service=redwood-inference-api, region=eu-west-3, target_release=release/v2.3.9). Command: `deployctl pin --service redwood-inference-api --region eu-west-3 --release v2.3.9`
ops: Pinned eu-west-3 back to v2.3.9. Routing check OK. Monitoring now.
samir: Receiving initial metrics — eu3 p95 back to ~115ms within 90s. error rate down to baseline. no more 502s in the last 2m.
emily: Nice. Keep the global paused state. ops, please collect logs from v2.4.0 eu hosts and attach to the ticket. I'll open a bug and assign to runtime-team.
ops: Filed BUG-4521 with logs and config diffs: https://internal.redwood/bugs/4521. Adding runtime-team, infra, and release owner.
jin: If root cause is prefetch_policy/aggressive+async-kv, we should test a combination flag matrix on staging before re-rolling.
lisa: Also add a note to release notes: rollback in eu-west-3 due to kv-cache timeouts. We'll update public notes after we confirm fix.
emily: Agree. Next steps: runtime-team triage, ops to run expanded telemetry for next 30m, then decide whether to roll forward eu3 with a config tweak or keep pin until 2.4.1. Can we keep the paused rollout for up to 60m?
ops: Yes, deployment will hold; alert if anything else drifts.
deploy-bot: Rollout status summary: service=redwood-inference-api, global=PAUSED at 10%, eu-west-3=PINNED->v2.3.9, us-east-1=10% on v2.4.0, rollout_id=rl_1860011222.
emily: Thanks all. I'll schedule a quick postmortem/triage sync in 30m and add notes in the changelog. Assigning samir to verify telemetry, jin to coordinate config matrix on staging, ops to collect infra logs, and runtime-team to own the bug.
samir: Will monitor for 30m and report back.
jin: Starting staging matrix tests now.
lisa: I'll draft the internal incident blurb for slack #incidents and wait for final wording after root cause.
ops: All done from infra side for now.
deploy-bot: Rollback action (regional) confirmed at 2026-03-22T19:09:45Z. No further automatic rollbacks triggered.
emily: Closing thread for now; reopen if new signals. Follow-up: postmortem doc link will be added once runtime-team triages. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
